subject: bia
title: BIA.------V.SY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 455 (TRF(CW)-27). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject; V-SY (value system) is the partner. From the subject: DEC (decentralization), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From DEC: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: PART (participation) and AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight) and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From IF-SPT: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From CULT-SOLD: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
